diff --git a/.github/workflows/release.yml b/.github/workflows/release.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3858c42
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/release.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,86 @@
+name: Release
+
+# Release flow:
+# 1. Merge conventional commits to main, CI keeps everything green
+# 2. Tag the release commit: `git tag v0.7.0 && git push origin v0.7.0`
+# 3. This workflow generates the git-cliff changelog, creates the GitHub
+#    release with the changelog as body and publishes the packages to JSR
+
+on:
+  push:
+    tags:
+      - 'v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+*'
+
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+  id-token: write
+
+jobs:
+  release:
+    name: Changelog, GitHub release and JSR publish
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    environment: release
+    steps:
+      - name: Clone repository
+        uses: actions/checkout@v7
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Set up Deno
+        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2
+        with:
+          deno-version: v2.x
+
+      - name: Set up pnpm
+        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Generate the changelog for the latest tag
+        uses: orhun/git-cliff-action@v4
+        id: git-cliff
+        with:
+          config: cliff.toml
+          args: --latest --strip header
+        env:
+          GITHUB_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
+
+      - name: Create the GitHub release
+        run: |
+          gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
+            --title "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
+            --notes "${{ steps.git-cliff.outputs.content }}" \
+            --verify-tag
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Update CHANGELOG.md
+        uses: orhun/git-cliff-action@v4
+        with:
+          config: cliff.toml
+          args: --verbose
+        env:
+          OUTPUT: CHANGELOG.md
+          GITHUB_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
+
+      - name: Commit the updated changelog
+        run: |
+          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
+          git config user.email 'github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
+          git add CHANGELOG.md
+          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "docs(changelog): update changelog for $GITHUB_REF_NAME [skip ci]"
+          git push origin HEAD:main
+        env:
+          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Dry run publish
+        run: |
+          deno publish --dry-run --allow-dirty
+        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
+
+      - name: Publish packages to JSR
+        run: |
+          deno publish --allow-dirty
+        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}

 ## Features
 
 - **Workspace Compatible**: Seamlessly integrates with monorepos and workspaces (Deno, pnpm, Cargo).

+The config file is a plain TypeScript module exporting a `ReadmeTemplateArgs` object:
+
+```ts
+import type * as types from '@readma/core'
+
+const config: types.ReadmeTemplateArgs = {
+  language: 'ts',
+  title: 'My project',
+  author: 'me',
+  githubUsername: 'me',
+  repoName: 'my-project',
+  xHandle: 'me',
+  domain: 'gmail',
+  email: 'me',
+  images: { logo: 'images/logo.png' },
+  template: { bugReport: 'bug-report.yml', featRequest: 'feature-request.yml' },
+  backToTop: true,
+  badges: {
+    disabled: ['issues'],
+    custom: [{ name: 'Sponsor', image: 'https://img.shields.io/badge/-Sponsor-purple', link: 'https://sponsor.me' }],
+  },
+  sections: {
+    features: '- Fast\n- Small',
+    projectDescription: 'A short description',
+    about: 'About the project',
+    installation: '```sh\ndeno add my-project\n```',

+## Development
+
+```bash
+pnpm i                 # install the workspace tooling (turbo, oxlint, lefthook...)
+deno task f            # format
+deno lint              # deno lint
+pnpm run lint:ox       # oxlint in pedantic mode
+deno task cov          # tests with a 100% coverage report
+pnpm exec lefthook install   # wire the git hooks
+```
+
+### Changelog and releases
+
+The changelog is generated with [git-cliff](https://git-cliff.org) from [conventional commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/):
+
+```bash
+git cliff -o CHANGELOG.md       # regenerate the full changelog
+git cliff --latest --strip header   # release notes for the latest tag
+```
+
+Releases are driven by tags: push a `v*` tag and the `release` workflow generates the changelog, creates the GitHub release and publishes the packages to [JSR](https://jsr.io).
+

+# git-cliff configuration, see https://git-cliff.org/docs/configuration
+# Changelog follows the Conventional Commits specification, grouped by type
+# and styled after the keep-a-changelog layout.
+# The config works fully offline: set GITHUB_REPO + GITHUB_TOKEN env vars to
+# additionally enrich commits with pull request metadata.
+
+[changelog]
+# Template rendered for each release
+body = """
+## [{% if version %}{{ version | trim_start_matches(pat="v") }}{% else %}Unreleased{% endif %}]\
+  {% if timestamp %} - {{ timestamp | date(format="%Y-%m-%d") }}{% endif %}
+{% if version %}\
+  {% if previous %}{% if previous.commit_id %}\
+    [compare: {{ previous.commit_id | truncate(length=7, end="") }}...{{ commit_id | truncate(length=7, end="") }}]\
+    (https://github.com/elcoosp/readma/compare/{{ previous.commit_id }}...{{ commit_id }})
+  {% endif %}{% endif %}\
+{% endif %}\
+
+{% for group, commits in commits | group_by(attribute="group") %}
+### {{ group | upper_first }}
+
+{% for commit in commits %}
+- {% if commit.scope %}*({{ commit.scope }})* {% endif %}\
+  {% if commit.breaking %}[**breaking**] {% endif %}\
+  {{ commit.message | upper_first }} ([{{ commit.id | truncate(length=7, end="") }}](https://github.com/elcoosp/readma/commit/{{ commit.id }}))
+{%- endfor %}
+{% endfor %}
+"""
+# Remove leading and trailing spaces from the body
+trim = true
+footer = """
+<!-- generated by git-cliff -->
+"""
+
+[git]
+# Parse commits according to conventional commits
+conventional_commits = true
+# Exclude commits that do not parse
+filter_unconventional = true
+# Split commits on newlines for the body processing
+split_commits = false
+# Protect breaking changes from being skipped
+protect_breaking_commits = true
+# Group commits by their conventional type
+commit_parsers = [
+  { message = "^feat", group = "🚀 Features" },
+  { message = "^fix", group = "🐛 Bug Fixes" },
+  { message = "^doc", group = "📚 Documentation" },
+  { message = "^perf", group = "⚡ Performance" },
+  { message = "^refactor", group = "🚜 Refactor" },
+  { message = "^style", group = "🎨 Styling" },
+  { message = "^test", group = "🧪 Testing" },
+  { message = "^chore\\(release\\)", skip = true },
+  { message = "^chore\\(deps.*\\)", skip = true },
+  { message = "^chore\\(pr\\)", skip = true },
+  { message = "^chore\\(scope\\)", skip = true },
+  { message = "^chore|^ci", group = "🚙 Miscellaneous" },
+  { body = ".*security", group = "🛡️ Security" },
+  { message = ".*", group = "💬 Other" },
+]
+# Filter out skipped commits
+filter_commits = true
+# Match release tags: v prefixed and legacy bare semver tags
+tag_pattern = "^v?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"
+# Sort commits inside a release
+sort_commits = "oldest"

+import {
+  BUILTIN_SECTION_KEYS,
+  getReadmaConfig,
+  ReadmaError,
+  type ReadmeTemplateArgs,
+} from '@readma/core'
+/** Loaded readma config */
+export type LoadedConfig = {
+  args: ReadmeTemplateArgs
+  /** Path of the loaded config file */
+  path: string
+}
+/**
+ * Load the readma config from the given root folder or file path
+ * @param configPath Folder containing a `readma.config.ts` or a direct file path
+ */
+export async function loadConfig(configPath = '.'): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const path = configPath
+  const args = await getReadmaConfig(path)
+  return { args, path }
+}
+/** Required fields of {@link ReadmeTemplateArgs} checked by {@link validateConfig} */
+export const REQUIRED_SECTION_KEYS = BUILTIN_SECTION_KEYS.filter(
+  (sectionKey) => sectionKey !== 'contributing',
+)
+/** Check that every required config field is present, return the missing ones */
+export function missingConfigFields(args: ReadmeTemplateArgs): string[] {
+  const missing: string[] = []
+  const check = (condition: boolean, name: string) => {
+    if (!condition) missing.push(name)
+  }
+  check(args.language !== undefined, 'language')
+  check(args.title !== undefined, 'title')
+  check(args.author !== undefined, 'author')
+  check(args.githubUsername !== undefined, 'githubUsername')
+  check(args.repoName !== undefined, 'repoName')
+  check(args.xHandle !== undefined, 'xHandle')
+  check(args.domain !== undefined, 'domain')
+  check(args.email !== undefined, 'email')
+  check(args.backToTop !== undefined, 'backToTop')
+  check(args.images?.logo !== undefined, 'images.logo')
+  check(args.template?.bugReport !== undefined, 'template.bugReport')
+  check(args.template?.featRequest !== undefined, 'template.featRequest')
+  for (const sectionKey of REQUIRED_SECTION_KEYS) {
+    check(
+      typeof args.sections?.[sectionKey] === 'string',
+      `sections.${sectionKey}`,
+    )
+  }
+  return missing
+}
+/** Validate the config, throwing a detailed {@link ReadmaError} when incomplete */
+export function validateConfig(args: ReadmeTemplateArgs): void {
+  const missing = missingConfigFields(args)
+  if (missing.length > 0) {
+    throw new ReadmaError(
+      `Missing required readma config fields: ${missing.join(', ')}`,
+    )
+  }

+import {
+  readWorkspaceManifest,
+  type WorkspaceManifest,
+} from '@pnpm/workspace.read-manifest'
+import { expandGlob } from '@std/fs'
+import * as jsonc from '@std/jsonc'
+import * as path from '@std/path'
+import * as toml from '@std/toml'
+import {
+  fetchJsonDescription,
+  type PackageRegistry,
+  ReadmaError,
+  readOptionalFile,
+  type SourceLanguage,
+  type WorkspaceMember,
+} from '@readma/core'
+import { loadPkgJson } from '@readma/pkg-json'
+/** Subset of a deno config file used for workspace detection */
+export type DenoFile = {
+  workspace?: string[]
+  name?: string
+  description?: string
+}
+/** Subset of a cargo manifest used for workspace detection */
+export type CargoFile = {
+  workspace?: { members?: string[] }
+  package?: { description?: string; name?: string }
+}
+/** Workspace detection options */
+export type DetectOptions = {
+  /** Skip every network call, descriptions default to `-` */
+  offline?: boolean
+  /** Injected fetch, default to globalThis fetch */
+  fetchFn?: typeof fetch
+  /** Scope used to fallback jsr package names, default to `readma` */
+  repoScope?: string
+}
+/** Result of the workspace detection */
+export type WorkspaceDetection = {
+  language: SourceLanguage
+  packageRegistry: PackageRegistry
+  files: {
+    deno?: DenoFile
+    rs?: CargoFile
+    pnpm?: WorkspaceManifest
+    pkgJson?: PackageJsonLike
+  }
+  members?: WorkspaceMember[]
+}
+/** Minimal package.json like type, see {@link PackageJson} */
+export type PackageJsonLike = {
+  name?: string
+  description?: string
+  private?: boolean
+}
+const DENO_FILENAMES = ['deno.jsonc', 'deno.json'] as const
+/** Parse the first matching configuration file among the given filenames */
+async function parseFirstFile<T>(
+  rootPath: string,
+  filenames: readonly string[],
+): Promise<T | undefined> {
+  for (const filename of filenames) {
+    const fileContent = await readOptionalFile(path.join(rootPath, filename))
+    if (fileContent !== undefined) {
+      const ext = path.extname(filename).slice(1)
+      const parserMap = {
+        json: JSON.parse,
+        jsonc: jsonc.parse,
+        toml: toml.parse,
+      } as const
+      const parser = parserMap[ext as keyof typeof parserMap]
+      return parser(fileContent) as T
+    }
+  }
+  return undefined
+}
+/** Derive the folder name of a given path */
+export const getFolderName = (x: string): string =>
+  x.split('/').findLast(Boolean) ?? x
+/** Detect the workspace members of a deno workspace */
+export async function denoMembers(
+  rootPath: string,
+  denoFile: DenoFile,
+  repoScope: string,
+  options: DetectOptions = {},
+): Promise<WorkspaceMember[]> {
+  const pathByKey = new Map<string, string>()
+  for (const entry of denoFile.workspace ?? []) {
+    if (entry.includes('*')) {
+      for await (
+        const file of expandGlob(
+          path.join(rootPath, entry, 'deno.{json,jsonc}'),
+          { exclude: ['**/node_modules/**'] },
+        )
+      ) {
+        const resolved = path.resolve(path.dirname(file.path))
+        if (!pathByKey.has(resolved)) {
+          pathByKey.set(resolved, path.relative(rootPath, resolved))
+        }
+      }
+    } else {
+      const resolved = path.resolve(path.join(rootPath, entry))
+      if (!pathByKey.has(resolved)) {
+        pathByKey.set(resolved, path.relative(rootPath, resolved))
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return await Promise.all(
+    [...pathByKey.entries()].map(async ([resolved, relativePath]) => {
+      const memberFile = await parseFirstFile<DenoFile>(
+        resolved,
+        DENO_FILENAMES,
+      )
+      const pkgName = memberFile?.name ??
+        `@${repoScope}/${getFolderName(relativePath)}`
+      const localDescription = memberFile?.description
+      const description = localDescription ??
+        (await fetchJsonDescription(
+          `https://npm.jsr.io/@jsr/${
+            pkgName.replace(/^@/u, '').replace('/', '__')
+          }`,
+          options.offline ?? false,
+          options.fetchFn,
+        )) ?? '-'
+      return { path: relativePath, pkgName, description }
+    }),
+  )
+}
+/** Detect the workspace members of a pnpm (or npm) workspace */
+export async function pnpmMembers(
+  rootPath: string,
+  manifest: WorkspaceManifest,
+): Promise<WorkspaceMember[]> {
+  const members: WorkspaceMember[] = []
+  for (const pkgsGlob of manifest.packages) {
+    for await (
+      const file of expandGlob(path.join(rootPath, pkgsGlob, 'package.json'), {
+        exclude: ['**/node_modules/**'],
+      })
+    ) {
+      const memberPath = path.relative(
+        rootPath,
+        path.resolve(path.dirname(file.path)),
+      )
+      const pkg = await loadPkgJson(path.join(rootPath, memberPath))
+      members.push({
+        path: memberPath,
+        pkgName: pkg.name ?? getFolderName(memberPath),
+        description: pkg.description ?? '-',
+      })
+    }
+  }
+  return members
+}
+/** Detect the workspace members of a cargo workspace */
+export async function cargoMembers(
+  rootPath: string,
+  cargoFile: CargoFile,
+): Promise<WorkspaceMember[]> {
+  const members = cargoFile.workspace?.members ?? []
+  return await Promise.all(
+    members.map(async (memberRelativePath) => {
+      const memberPath = path.join(rootPath, memberRelativePath)
+      const memberFile = await parseFirstFile<CargoFile>(
+        memberPath,
+        ['Cargo.toml'],
+      )
+      return {
+        path: memberPath,
+        pkgName: memberFile?.package?.name ??
+          getFolderName(memberRelativePath),
+        description: memberFile?.package?.description ?? '-',
+      }
+    }),
+  )
+}
+
+/** Derive the package registry from the detected ecosystem files */
+function registryFor(
+  hasDenoFiles: boolean,
+  pnpmManifest: WorkspaceManifest | undefined,
+  rootPkgJson: PackageJsonLike | undefined,
+): PackageRegistry {
+  if (hasDenoFiles) return 'jsr'
+  if (pnpmManifest !== undefined || rootPkgJson !== undefined) return 'npm'
+  return 'crates.io'
+}
+
+/** Detect the workspace members matching the detected registry */
+async function detectMembers(detection: {
+  packageRegistry: PackageRegistry
+  rootPath: string
+  rsFile?: CargoFile
+  denoFile?: DenoFile
+  pnpmManifest?: WorkspaceManifest
+  options: DetectOptions
+}): Promise<WorkspaceMember[] | undefined> {
+  if (detection.packageRegistry === 'crates.io') {
+    return await cargoMembers(detection.rootPath, detection.rsFile as CargoFile)
+  }
+  if (detection.packageRegistry === 'jsr') {
+    return await denoMembers(
+      detection.rootPath,
+      detection.denoFile as DenoFile,
+      detection.options.repoScope ?? 'readma',
+      detection.options,
+    )
+  }
+  if (detection.pnpmManifest) {
+    return await pnpmMembers(detection.rootPath, detection.pnpmManifest)
+  }
+  return undefined
+}
+
+/**
+ * Detect the language, package registry and workspace members of the project
+ * found at the given root path
+ */
+export async function detectWorkspace(
+  rootPath = '.',
+  options: DetectOptions = {},
+): Promise<WorkspaceDetection> {
+  const [denoFile, rsFile, pnpmManifest] = await Promise.all([
+    parseFirstFile<DenoFile>(rootPath, DENO_FILENAMES),
+    parseFirstFile<CargoFile>(rootPath, ['Cargo.toml']),
+    readWorkspaceManifest(rootPath),
+  ])
+  const hasDenoFiles = denoFile !== undefined
+  const hasRsFiles = rsFile !== undefined
+  if (hasRsFiles && hasDenoFiles) {
+    throw new ReadmaError(
+      'Found both a deno and rust configuration file, not supported yet',
+    )
+  }
+  const rootPkgJson = await parseFirstFile<PackageJsonLike>(rootPath, [
+    'package.json',
+  ])
+  const isTs = hasDenoFiles || pnpmManifest !== undefined ||
+    rootPkgJson !== undefined
+  if (!isTs && !hasRsFiles) {
+    throw new ReadmaError('Could not detect language')
+  }
+  const language: SourceLanguage = isTs ? 'ts' : 'rs'
+  const packageRegistry: PackageRegistry = registryFor(
+    hasDenoFiles,
+    pnpmManifest,
+    rootPkgJson,
+  )
+  const members = await detectMembers({
+    packageRegistry,
+    rootPath,
+    rsFile,
+    denoFile,
+    pnpmManifest,
+    options,
+  })
+  return {
+    packageRegistry,
+    language,
+    files: {
+      deno: denoFile,
+      rs: rsFile,
+      pnpm: pnpmManifest,
+      pkgJson: rootPkgJson,
+    },
+    members,
+  }
+}

+/** Options of the `gen` command */
+export type GenOptions = {
+  /** Project root path, default to the current working directory */
+  rootPath?: string
+  /** Render but skip the file writes */
+  dryRun?: boolean
+  /** Print the rendered markdown to stdout instead of writing files */
+  stdout?: boolean
+  /** Compare the rendered output with the existing files, exit with code 2 when out of sync */
+  check?: boolean
+  /** Path to the config folder or file, relative to the root path */
+  configPath?: string
+  /** Only generate the workspace root readme */
+  rootOnly?: boolean
+  /** Only generate the workspace member readmes */
+  membersOnly?: boolean
+  /** Only generate the readme of a specific member path */
+  member?: string
+  /** Skip every network call */
+  offline?: boolean
+  /** Verbose logging */
+  verbose?: boolean
+}
+/** Result of the `gen` command */
+export type GenResult = {
+  /** Files written (empty in dry run, stdout and check modes) */
+  written: string[]
+  /** Rendered contents with their target paths */
+  rendered: { path: string; content: string }[]
+  /** Paths out of sync in check mode */
+  changed: string[]
+  /** Whether the command ran in check mode */
+  check: boolean
+}
+/** Custom mdx section overrides found inside a member folder, empty or broken files are skipped */
+async function memberMdxSections(
+  memberPath: string,
+  sectionKeys: string[],
+  verbose: boolean,
+): Promise<Record<string, string>> {
+  const entries = await Promise.all(
+    sectionKeys.map(async (sectionName) => {
+      const sectionPath = path.join(
+        memberPath,
+        'readma',
+        'sections',
+        `${sectionName}.mdx`,
+      )
+      try {
+        const mdxProcessed = await mdx.processFile(sectionPath)
+        if (mdxProcessed) {
+          logger.debug(`Found custom mdx section at ${sectionPath}`)
+          return [sectionName, mdxProcessed] as const
+        }
+        return undefined
+      } catch (error) {
+        if (verbose) {
+          logger.warn(
+            `Could not process ${sectionPath}, falling back to the config value: ${error}`,
+          )
+        }
+        return undefined
+      }
+    }),
+  )
+  return Object.fromEntries(
+    entries.filter((entry) => entry !== undefined),
+  ) as Record<string, string>
+}
+/** Build the template args of a workspace member readme */
+export async function buildMemberArgs(
+  config: ReadmeTemplateArgs,
+  member: WorkspaceMember,
+  language: ReadmeTemplateArgs['language'],
+  packageRegistry: ReadmeTemplateArgs['packageRegistry'],
+  opts: { verbose?: boolean; absMemberPath?: string } = {},
+): Promise<ReadmeTemplateArgs> {
+  const mdxSections = await memberMdxSections(
+    opts.absMemberPath ?? member.path,
+    Object.keys(config.sections),
+    opts.verbose ?? false,
+  )
+  const installation = mdxSections.installation ??
+    installSnippet(member.pkgName, language, packageRegistry) ?? ''
+  return deepmerge(config, {
+    packageRegistry,
+    sections: { ...config.sections, ...mdxSections, installation },
+    workspaceMember: member,
+  }) as ReadmeTemplateArgs
+}
+/** Installation snippet derived from the config value or the language and registry */
+export function resolveInstallation(
+  configInstallation: string | undefined,
+  pkgName: string,
+  language: ReadmeTemplateArgs['language'],
+  packageRegistry: ReadmeTemplateArgs['packageRegistry'],
+): string {
+  return configInstallation ||
+    installSnippet(pkgName, language, packageRegistry) ||
+    ''
+}
+/** Root package name derived from the detection files, used for the root installation snippet */
+function rootPkgName(
+  files: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof detectWorkspace>>['files'],
+): string | undefined {
+  return files.deno?.name ?? files.rs?.package?.name ?? files.pkgJson?.name
+}
+/**
+ * Run the `gen` command: detect the workspace, build the member and root
+ * readme args, then render and optionally write the readmes
+ */
+export async function runGen(opts: GenOptions = {}): Promise<GenResult> {
+  setLogLevel(opts.verbose ? 'debug' : 'info')
+  const rootPath = path.resolve(opts.rootPath ?? '.')
+  const { args: config } = await loadConfig(
+    opts.configPath ? path.resolve(rootPath, opts.configPath) : rootPath,
+  )
+  validateConfig(config)
+  logger.info('Starting readma generation')
+  const detection = await detectWorkspace(rootPath, { offline: opts.offline })
+  const { language, packageRegistry, members, files } = detection
+  logger.debug(`Detected ${language} project with ${packageRegistry} registry`)
+  const targets: { args: ReadmeTemplateArgs; absFolderPath: string }[] = []
+  const selectedMembers = (members ?? []).filter((member) =>
+    opts.member
+      ? member.path === opts.member ||
+        path.resolve(rootPath, member.path) === path.resolve(opts.member)
+      : true
+  )
+  if (opts.member && selectedMembers.length === 0) {
+    throw new Error(`Could not find a workspace member at path ${opts.member}`)
+  }
+  if (!opts.rootOnly) {
+    for (const member of selectedMembers) {
+      const absMemberPath = path.resolve(rootPath, member.path)
+      const memberArgs = await buildMemberArgs(
+        config,
+        member,
+        language,
+        packageRegistry,
+        { ...opts, absMemberPath },
+      )
+      targets.push({ args: memberArgs, absFolderPath: absMemberPath })
+    }
+  }
+  const rootInstallation = resolveInstallation(
+    config.sections.installation,
+    rootPkgName(files) ?? config.repoName,
+    language,
+    packageRegistry,
+  )
+  if (!opts.membersOnly) {
+    targets.push({
+      args: deepmerge(config, {
+        packageRegistry,
+        sections: { ...config.sections, installation: rootInstallation },
+        root: { members: selectedMembers },
+      }) as ReadmeTemplateArgs,
+      absFolderPath: rootPath,
+    })
+  }
+  const result: GenResult = {
+    written: [],
+    rendered: [],
+    changed: [],
+    check: opts.check ?? false,
+  }
+  await Promise.all(
+    targets.map(async (target) => {
+      const readmePath = path.join(target.absFolderPath, 'README.md')
+      logger.info(
+        `Rendering "${
+          target.args.workspaceMember?.pkgName ?? 'workspace root'
+        }" readme`,
+      )
+      const render = () =>
+        readme(target.args, { folderPath: target.absFolderPath })
+      if (opts.check) {
+        const rendered = await render()
+        const existing = await Deno.readTextFile(readmePath).catch(() =>
+          undefined
+        )
+        if (existing !== rendered) result.changed.push(readmePath)
+        result.rendered.push({ path: readmePath, content: rendered })
+        return
+      }
+      if (opts.stdout || opts.dryRun) {
+        const rendered = await render()
+        result.rendered.push({ path: readmePath, content: rendered })
+        if (opts.stdout) console.log(rendered)
+        return
+      }
+      const rendered = await writeReadme(target.args, {
+        folderPath: target.absFolderPath,
+      })
+      result.written.push(readmePath)
+      result.rendered.push({ path: readmePath, content: rendered })
+    }),
+  )
+  if (opts.check && result.changed.length > 0) {
+    logger.error(`Readmes out of sync: ${result.changed.join(', ')}`)
+  }
+  return result
+}

+import * as path from '@std/path'

+  force?: boolean
+  /** Target config file path, default to `readma.config.ts` inside the root path */
+  configPath?: string
+  /** Return the config content without writing it */
+  dryRun?: boolean
+  /** Project root path, default to the current working directory */

+  /** Path of the config file */
+  configPath: string
+  /** Generated config content */
+  content: string

+  written: boolean

+/** Parse a git remote url into a github username and repository name */
+export function parseGitRemote(
+  remoteUrl: string,
+): { username?: string; repoName?: string } {
+  const sshMatch = remoteUrl.match(
+    /^git@github\.com:(?<username>[^/]+)\/(?<repoName>.+?)(?:\.git)?$/u,
+  )
+  if (sshMatch?.groups) {
+    return {
+      username: sshMatch.groups.username,
+      repoName: sshMatch.groups.repoName,
+    }
+  }
+  const httpsMatch = remoteUrl.match(
+    /^https?:\/\/github\.com\/(?<username>[^/]+)\/(?<repoName>.+?)(?:\.git)?$/u,
+  )
+  if (httpsMatch?.groups) {
+    return {
+      username: httpsMatch.groups.username,
+      repoName: httpsMatch.groups.repoName,
+    }
+  }
+  return {}
+}
+/** Derive the github username and repo name from the local git remote */
+export async function detectGithubRemote(
+  rootPath = '.',
+): Promise<{ username?: string; repoName?: string }> {
+  try {
+    const result = await io.runCommand({
+      cmd: 'git',
+      args: ['config', '--get', 'remote.origin.url'],
+      cwd: rootPath,
+    })
+    if (!result.success) return {}
+    return parseGitRemote(result.stdout.trim())
+  } catch {
+    return {}
+  }
+}
+/** Generate the content of a `readma.config.ts` file */
+export function generateInitConfig(
+  detection: WorkspaceDetection,
+  detected: {
+    username?: string
+    repoName?: string
+    licenseId?: string
+  },
+): string {
+  const username = detected.username ?? 'your-github-username'
+  const repoName = detected.repoName ?? 'your-repo-name'
+  return `import type * as types from '@readma/core'
+
+const urls = {
+  doc: \`https://github.com/${username}/${repoName}\`,
+}
+
+const config: types.ReadmeTemplateArgs = {
+  language: '${detection.language}',
+  title: '${repoName}',
+  author: '${username}',
+  githubUsername: '${username}',
+  repoName: '${repoName}',
+  xHandle: '${username}',
+  domain: 'gmail',
+  email: '${username}',
+  urls,
+  images: { logo: 'images/logo.png' },
+  sections: {
+    features: \`
+- Feature one
+- Feature two\`,
+    projectDescription: 'A short description of your project',
+    about: 'Tell more about the project',
+    installation: 'Installation instructions',
+    acknowledgments: \`
+- [Best Readme](https://github.com/othneildrew/Best-README-Template)\`,
+    gettingStarted: 'Getting started instructions',
+    usage: 'Usage instructions',
+    roadmap: \`
+- [ ] Roadmap item\`,
+  },
+  template: {
+    bugReport: 'bug-report.yml',
+    featRequest: 'feature-request.yml',
+  },
+  backToTop: true,
+  license: '${detected.licenseId ?? 'MIT'}',
+  packageRegistry: '${detection.packageRegistry}',
+}
+
+export default config
+`
+}
+/**
+ * Run the `init` command: scaffold a `readma.config.ts` pre filled with the
+ * locally detected git remote, language, registry and license
+ */
+export async function runInit(
+  opts: InitOptions = {},
+): Promise<InitResult> {
+  const rootPath = path.resolve(opts.rootPath ?? '.')
+  const targetPath = opts.configPath
+    ? path.resolve(rootPath, opts.configPath)
+    : path.join(rootPath, 'readma.config.ts')
+  const existing = await Deno.readTextFile(targetPath).then(
+    () => true,
+    () => false,
+  )
+  if (existing && !opts.force) {
+    throw new ReadmaError(
+      `${targetPath} already exists, use the --force flag to overwrite it`,
+    )
+  }
+  const detection = await detectWorkspace(rootPath)
+  const gitRemote = await detectGithubRemote(rootPath)
+  const license = await detectLicense(rootPath)
+  const licenseId = license.id
+  const content = generateInitConfig(detection, {
+    username: gitRemote.username,
+    repoName: gitRemote.repoName,
+    licenseId,
+  })
+  if (!opts.dryRun) {
+    await Deno.writeTextFile(targetPath, content)
+    logger.info(`Scaffolded ${targetPath}`)
+  }
+  return { configPath: targetPath, content, written: !opts.dryRun }

+/** Log levels supported by the cli logger */
+export type LogLevel = 'debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error'
+const LEVEL_ORDER: Record<LogLevel, number> = {
+  debug: 0,
+  info: 1,
+  warn: 2,
+  error: 3,
+}
+let currentLevel: LogLevel = 'info'
+/** Change the minimum level which gets printed */
+export function setLogLevel(level: LogLevel): void {
+  currentLevel = level
+}
+/** Print a message if the level is above the current minimum level */
+export function log(level: LogLevel, message: string): void {
+  if (LEVEL_ORDER[level] < LEVEL_ORDER[currentLevel]) return
+  const prefix = level === 'info' ? '' : `[${level}] `
+  console.log(`${prefix}${message}`)
+}
+/** Leveled cli logger */
+export const logger = {
+  debug: (message: string) => log('debug', message),
+  info: (message: string) => log('info', message),
+  warn: (message: string) => log('warn', message),
+  error: (message: string) => log('error', message),
+}

+import * as path from '@std/path'
+import { readOptionalFile } from '@readma/core'
+import { loadConfig, missingConfigFields } from './config.ts'
+import { logger } from './logger.ts'
+/** Options of the `validate` command */
+export type ValidateOptions = {
+  /** Path to the config folder or file */
+  configPath?: string
+  /** Project root path, default to the current working directory */
+  rootPath?: string
+}
+/** A single validation finding */
+export type ValidationIssue = {
+  level: 'error' | 'warn'
+  message: string
+}
+/** Result of the `validate` command */
+export type ValidationResult = {
+  issues: ValidationIssue[]
+  /** True when no error level issue was found */
+  ok: boolean
+}
+/** Check that a file exists relative to the config root */
+async function checkFile(
+  issues: ValidationIssue[],
+  rootPath: string,
+  filePath: string | undefined,
+  label: string,
+): Promise<void> {
+  if (filePath === undefined) return
+  const resolved = path.join(rootPath, filePath)
+  const content = await readOptionalFile(resolved)
+  if (content === undefined) {
+    issues.push({
+      level: 'error',
+      message: `${label} not found at ${resolved}`,
+    })
+  }
+}
+/**
+ * Run the `validate` command: check the config completeness and every file it
+ * references (images, issue templates, code of conduct, license)
+ */
+export async function runValidate(
+  opts: ValidateOptions = {},
+): Promise<ValidationResult> {
+  const rootPath = path.resolve(opts.rootPath ?? '.')
+  const { args, path: configPath } = await loadConfig(
+    opts.configPath ? path.resolve(rootPath, opts.configPath) : rootPath,
+  )
+  const issues: ValidationIssue[] = []
+  const missing = missingConfigFields(args)
+  for (const field of missing) {
+    issues.push({
+      level: 'error',
+      message: `Missing required config field ${field}`,
+    })
+  }
+  await checkFile(issues, rootPath, args.images?.logo, 'Logo image')
+  await checkFile(issues, rootPath, args.images?.screenshot, 'Screenshot image')
+  await checkFile(
+    issues,
+    rootPath,
+    args.template?.bugReport === undefined
+      ? undefined
+      : path.join('.github', 'ISSUE_TEMPLATE', args.template.bugReport),
+    'Bug report issue template',
+  )
+  await checkFile(
+    issues,
+    rootPath,
+    args.template?.featRequest === undefined
+      ? undefined
+      : path.join('.github', 'ISSUE_TEMPLATE', args.template.featRequest),
+    'Feature request issue template',
+  )
+  await checkFile(issues, rootPath, args.coc, 'Code of conduct file')
+  await checkFile(issues, rootPath, args.licenseFile, 'License file')
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(args.sections ?? {})) {
+    if (typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() === '') {
+      issues.push({
+        level: 'warn',
+        message: `Section ${key} is empty, it will be omitted from the readme`,
+      })
+    }
+  }
+  if (args.license && !args.licenseFile) {
+    const licenseContent = await readOptionalFile(
+      path.join(rootPath, 'LICENSE.txt'),
+    )
+    if (licenseContent === undefined) {
+      issues.push({
+        level: 'warn',
+        message:
+          'No LICENSE.txt found next to the config, pass a licenseFile field if your license lives elsewhere',
+      })
+    }
+  }
+  if (issues.length === 0) {
+    logger.info(`Config at ${configPath} is valid`)
+  }
+  return { issues, ok: !issues.some((issue) => issue.level === 'error') }
+}

+    usage: 'Usage body',
+    '🧪 Custom': 'Custom body',
+  },

+    'logo.png': 'logo',

+      "title: Bug\nlabels: ['bug']\nassignees: []",
+    '.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feat.yml':
+      "title: Feat\nlabels: ['feat']\nassignees: []",

+      name: 'pkg-a',
+      description: 'Package A',

+    'packages/a/readma/sections/features.mdx': 'Custom **features** body',

+    await Deno.mkdir(resolved.slice(0, resolved.lastIndexOf('/')), {
+      recursive: true,

+Deno.test('runGen writes member and root readmes', async (t) => {
+  const dir = await makeWorkspace()
+  try {
+    await t.step('full generation', async () => {
+      const result = await runGen({ ...baseOpts, rootPath: dir })
+      assertEquals(result.written.length, 3)
+      assertEquals(
+        result.written.some((p) => p.endsWith('packages/a/README.md')),
+        true,
+      )
+      assertEquals(
+        result.written.some((p) => p.endsWith('packages/b/README.md')),
+        true,
+      )
+      assertEquals(
+        result.written.some((p) =>
+          p.endsWith('/README.md') && !p.includes('packages/')
+        ),
+        true,
+      )
+      const memberA = result.rendered.find((r) =>
+        r.path.endsWith('packages/a/README.md')
+      )
+      assertEquals(
+        memberA?.content.includes('Custom <strong>features</strong> body'),
+        true,
+      )
+      assertEquals(memberA?.content.includes('pkg-a'), true)
+      assertEquals(memberA?.content.includes('pnpm add pkg-a'), true)
+      const root = result.rendered.find((r) =>
+        r.path.endsWith('/README.md') && !r.path.includes('packages/')
+      )
+      assertEquals(root?.content.includes('A test project'), true)
+      assertEquals(root?.content.includes('## 🧪 Custom'), true)
+      assertEquals(root?.content.includes('[pkg-a](packages/a)'), true)
+      assertEquals(root?.content.includes('Package A'), true)
+      assertEquals(root?.content.includes('MIT license'), true)
+      const memberB = result.rendered.find((r) =>
+        r.path.endsWith('packages/b/README.md')
+      )
+      assertEquals(memberB?.content.includes('pnpm add pkg-b'), true)
+    })
+    await t.step('check mode detects out of sync files', async () => {
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(`${dir}/packages/a/README.md`, 'stale')
+      const result = await runGen({ ...baseOpts, rootPath: dir, check: true })
+      assertEquals(result.changed.length, 1)
+      assertEquals(result.changed[0].endsWith('packages/a/README.md'), true)
+      await runGen({ ...baseOpts, rootPath: dir })
+      const clean = await runGen({ ...baseOpts, rootPath: dir, check: true })
+      assertEquals(clean.changed.length, 0)
+    })
+    await t.step('dryRun does not write', async () => {
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(`${dir}/packages/b/README.md`, 'untouched')
+      const result = await runGen({ ...baseOpts, rootPath: dir, dryRun: true })
+      assertEquals(result.written.length, 0)
+      assertEquals(result.rendered.length, 3)
+      assertEquals(
+        await Deno.readTextFile(`${dir}/packages/b/README.md`),
+        'untouched',
+      )
+    })
+    await t.step('rootOnly and membersOnly', async () => {
+      const rootOnly = await runGen({
+        ...baseOpts,
+        rootPath: dir,
+        rootOnly: true,
+      })
+      assertEquals(rootOnly.rendered.length, 1)
+      assertEquals(rootOnly.rendered[0].path.endsWith('/README.md'), true)
+      const membersOnly = await runGen({
+        ...baseOpts,
+        rootPath: dir,
+        membersOnly: true,
+      })
+      assertEquals(membersOnly.rendered.length, 2)
+    })
+    await t.step('member filter', async () => {
+      const filtered = await runGen({
+        ...baseOpts,
+        rootPath: dir,
+        member: 'packages/a',
+        membersOnly: true,
+      })
+      assertEquals(filtered.rendered.length, 1)
+      assertEquals(
+        filtered.rendered[0].path.endsWith('packages/a/README.md'),
+        true,
+      )
+      const absolute = await runGen({
+        ...baseOpts,
+        rootPath: dir,
+        member: `${dir}/packages/b`,
+        membersOnly: true,
+      })
+      assertEquals(absolute.rendered.length, 1)
+      assertEquals(
+        absolute.rendered[0].path.endsWith('packages/b/README.md'),
+        true,
+      )
+      const error = await assertRejects(() =>
+        runGen({ ...baseOpts, rootPath: dir, member: 'packages/unknown' })
+      )
+      assertEquals((error as Error).message.includes('packages/unknown'), true)
+    })
+    await t.step('stdout prints without writing', async () => {
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(`${dir}/packages/b/README.md`, 'untouched')
+      const result = await runGen({ ...baseOpts, rootPath: dir, stdout: true })
+      assertEquals(result.written.length, 0)
+      assertEquals(result.rendered.length, 3)
+      assertEquals(
+        await Deno.readTextFile(`${dir}/packages/b/README.md`),
+        'untouched',
+      )
+    })
+    await t.step('custom mdx section and installation override', async () => {
+      await Deno.mkdir(`${dir}/packages/b/readma/sections`, { recursive: true })
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(
+        `${dir}/packages/b/readma/sections/installation.mdx`,
+        'Custom install',
+      )
+      const result = await runGen({
+        ...baseOpts,
+        rootPath: dir,
+        member: 'packages/b',
+        membersOnly: true,
+      })
+      assertEquals(result.rendered[0].content.includes('Custom install'), true)
+      await Deno.remove(`${dir}/packages/b/readma`, { recursive: true })
+    })
+    await t.step('broken mdx section falls back to config', async () => {
+      await Deno.mkdir(`${dir}/packages/b/readma/sections`, { recursive: true })
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(
+        `${dir}/packages/b/readma/sections/features.mdx`,
+        '<NotAComponent />',
+      )
+      const result = await runGen({
+        ...baseOpts,
+        rootPath: dir,
+        member: 'packages/b',
+        membersOnly: true,
+      })
+      assertEquals(result.rendered[0].content.includes('Feature list'), true)
+      await Deno.remove(`${dir}/packages/b/readma`, { recursive: true })
+    })
+  } finally {
+    await Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+  }
+})

+Deno.test('runCli end to end', async (t) => {
+  const dir = await makeWorkspace()
+  try {
+    await t.step('schema subcommand prints json', async () => {
+      const logs: string[] = []
+      const originalLog = console.log
+      console.log = (message: string) => logs.push(message)
+      try {
+        await runCli(['schema'])
+      } finally {
+        console.log = originalLog
+      }
+      const printed = logs.join('\n')
+      assertEquals(JSON.parse(printed).properties.sections !== undefined, true)
+    })
+    await t.step('main command warns', async () => {
+      const logs: string[] = []
+      const originalLog = console.log
+      console.log = (message: string) => logs.push(message)
+      try {
+        await runCli([])
+        await runCli(['--debug'])
+      } finally {
+        console.log = originalLog
+      }
+      assertEquals(logs.join('\n').includes('subcommands'), true)
+    })
+    await t.step('gen stdout through the command', async () => {
+      const logs: string[] = []
+      const originalLog = console.log
+      console.log = (message: string) => logs.push(message)
+      try {
+        await runCli(['--root', dir, 'gen', '--stdout', '--debug'])
+      } finally {
+        console.log = originalLog
+      }
+      const printed = logs.join('\n')
+      assertEquals(printed.includes('A test project'), true)
+    })
+    await t.step('gen check returns the check exit code', async () => {
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(`${dir}/packages/b/README.md`, 'stale')
+      const exitCode = await runCli(['--root', dir, 'gen', '--check'])
+      assertEquals(exitCode, CHECK_EXIT_CODE)
+      assertEquals(CHECK_EXIT_CODE, 2)
+      await runCli(['--root', dir, 'gen'])
+      const clean = await runCli(['--root', dir, 'gen', '--check'])
+      assertEquals(clean, 0)
+    })
+    await t.step('init scaffolds through the command', async () => {
+      const initDir = `${dir}/init-target`
+      await Deno.mkdir(initDir)
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(
+        `${initDir}/package.json`,
+        JSON.stringify({ name: 'init-pkg' }),
+      )
+      setIo({
+        runCommand: ({ args }) =>
+          Promise.resolve({
+            success: true,
+            stdout: args.includes('remote.origin.url')
+              ? 'git@github.com:octocat/init-repo.git\n'
+              : '',
+            stderr: '',
+          }),
+      })
+      try {
+        const exitCode = await runCli([
+          '--root',
+          initDir,
+          'init',
+          '--dry-run',
+          '--debug',
+        ])
+        assertEquals(exitCode, 0)
+        const forced = await runCli([
+          '--root',
+          initDir,
+          'init',
+          '--force',
+          '--config',
+          'custom.config.ts',
+        ])
+        assertEquals(forced, 0)
+      } finally {
+        resetIo()
+      }
+      const written = await Deno.readTextFile(`${initDir}/custom.config.ts`)
+      assertEquals(written.includes('octocat'), true)
+      assertEquals(written.includes('init-repo'), true)
+    })
+    await t.step('validate returns the validate exit code', async () => {
+      const exitCode = await runCli(['--root', dir, 'validate', '--debug'])
+      assertEquals(exitCode, 0)
+      const emptyDir = `${dir}/empty-target`
+      await Deno.mkdir(emptyDir)
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(
+        `${emptyDir}/readma.config.ts`,
+        'export default {}',
+      )
+      const failing = await runCli(['--root', emptyDir, 'validate'])
+      assertEquals(failing, VALIDATE_EXIT_CODE)
+      assertEquals(VALIDATE_EXIT_CODE, 1)
+    })
+  } finally {
+    await Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+  }
+})

+Deno.test('runGen on deno and cargo workspaces', async (t) => {
+  const mk = async (files: Record<string, string>): Promise<string> => {
+    const dir = await Deno.makeTempDir()
+    for (const [filePath, content] of Object.entries(files)) {
+      const resolved = `${dir}/${filePath}`
+      await Deno.mkdir(resolved.slice(0, resolved.lastIndexOf('/')), {
+        recursive: true,
+      })
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(resolved, content)
+    }
+    return dir
+  }
+  const config = `export default {
+  language: 'ts', title: 'Ws', author: 'octo', githubUsername: 'octo',
+  repoName: 'ws', xHandle: 'octo', domain: 'gmail', email: 'octo',
+  backToTop: false, images: { logo: 'logo.png' },
+  template: { bugReport: 'bug.yml', featRequest: 'feat.yml' },
+  sections: {
+    features: 'f', projectDescription: 'p', about: 'a', installation: '',
+    acknowledgments: 'k', gettingStarted: 'g', roadmap: 'r', usage: 'u',
+  },
+}`
+  await t.step('deno workspace uses the root deno name', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({
+      'deno.json': JSON.stringify({
+        name: '@scope/root',
+        workspace: ['packages/core'],
+      }),
+      'packages/core/deno.json': JSON.stringify({ name: '@scope/core' }),
+      'readma.config.ts': config,
+    })
+    try {
+      const result = await runGen({
+        rootPath: dir,
+        dryRun: true,
+        offline: true,
+      })
+      const root = result.rendered.find((r) => r.path === `${dir}/README.md`)
+      assertEquals(root?.content.includes('deno add @scope/root'), true)
+      const member = result.rendered.find((r) =>
+        r.path === `${dir}/packages/core/README.md`
+      )
+      assertEquals(member?.content.includes('deno add @scope/core'), true)
+    } finally {
+      await Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+    }
+  })
+  await t.step('cargo workspace uses the root crate name', async () => {
+    const cargoConfig = config.replace("language: 'ts'", "language: 'rs'")
+    const dir = await mk({
+      'Cargo.toml':
+        '[workspace]\nmembers = ["crates/one"]\n\n[package]\nname = "root-crate"',
+      'crates/one/Cargo.toml':
+        '[package]\nname = "crate-one"\ndescription = "One"',
+      'readma.config.ts': cargoConfig,
+    })
+    try {
+      const result = await runGen({ rootPath: dir, dryRun: true })
+      const root = result.rendered.find((r) => r.path === `${dir}/README.md`)
+      assertEquals(root?.content.includes('cargo add root-crate'), true)
+      const member = result.rendered.find((r) =>
+        r.path === `${dir}/crates/one/README.md`
+      )
+      assertEquals(member?.content.includes('cargo add crate-one'), true)
+    } finally {
+      await Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+    }
+  })
+})

+Deno.test('detectWorkspace', async (t) => {
+  const mk = async (files: Record<string, string>): Promise<string> => {
+    const dir = await Deno.makeTempDir()
+    for (const [filePath, content] of Object.entries(files)) {
+      const resolved = `${dir}/${filePath}`
+      await Deno.mkdir(resolved.slice(0, resolved.lastIndexOf('/')), {
+        recursive: true,
+      })
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(resolved, content)
+    }
+    return dir
+  }
+  const rm = (dir: string) => Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+
+  await t.step('deno workspace with member configs', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({
+      'deno.json': JSON.stringify({
+        name: '@scope/root',
+        description: 'Root',
+        workspace: ['packages/core', 'packages/*'],
+      }),
+      'packages/core/deno.json': JSON.stringify({
+        name: '@scope/core',
+        description: 'Core package',
+      }),
+      'packages/cli/deno.json': JSON.stringify({ name: '@scope/cli' }),
+    })
+    try {
+      const detection = await detectWorkspace(dir, {
+        offline: true,
+        repoScope: 'scope',
+      })
+      assertEquals(detection.language, 'ts')
+      assertEquals(detection.packageRegistry, 'jsr')
+      assertEquals(detection.members?.length, 2)
+      const core = detection.members?.find((m) => m.path.endsWith('core'))
+      assertEquals(core?.pkgName, '@scope/core')
+      assertEquals(core?.description, 'Core package')
+      const cli = detection.members?.find((m) => m.path.endsWith('cli'))
+      assertEquals(cli?.pkgName, '@scope/cli')
+      assertEquals(cli?.description, '-')
+      assertEquals(detection.files.deno?.name, '@scope/root')
+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+  })
+
+  await t.step('deno workspace fetches missing descriptions', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({
+      'deno.json': JSON.stringify({ workspace: ['packages/core'] }),
+      'packages/core/deno.json': JSON.stringify({ name: '@scope/core' }),
+    })
+    try {
+      let fetchCalls = 0
+      const detection = await detectWorkspace(dir, {
+        repoScope: 'scope',
+        fetchFn: ((input: string | URL) => {
+          fetchCalls++
+          assertEquals(String(input).includes('jsr.io'), true)
+          return Promise.resolve(
+            Response.json({ description: 'Fetched desc' }, { status: 200 }),
+          )
+        }) as typeof fetch,
+      })
+      assertEquals(fetchCalls, 1)
+      assertEquals(detection.members?.[0]?.description, 'Fetched desc')
+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+  })
+
+  await t.step('pnpm workspace members', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({
+      'pnpm-workspace.yaml': 'packages:\n  - packages/**\n',
+      'packages/a/package.json': JSON.stringify({
+        name: 'pkg-a',
+        description: 'Package A',
+      }),
+      'packages/b/package.json': JSON.stringify({ name: 'pkg-b' }),
+      'packages/b/node_modules/ignore/package.json': '{}',
+    })
+    try {
+      const detection = await detectWorkspace(dir)
+      assertEquals(detection.packageRegistry, 'npm')
+      assertEquals(detection.language, 'ts')
+      const names = detection.members?.map((m) => m.pkgName).toSorted()
+      assertEquals(names, ['pkg-a', 'pkg-b'])
+      assertEquals(
+        detection.members?.find((m) => m.pkgName === 'pkg-b')?.description,
+        '-',
+      )
+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+  })
+
+  await t.step('plain npm repo has no members', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({
+      'package.json': JSON.stringify({ name: 'single-pkg' }),
+    })
+    try {
+      const detection = await detectWorkspace(dir)
+      assertEquals(detection.packageRegistry, 'npm')
+      assertEquals(detection.language, 'ts')
+      assertEquals(detection.members, undefined)
+      assertEquals(detection.files.pkgJson?.name, 'single-pkg')
+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+  })
+
+  await t.step('deno and pnpm members fall back to folder names', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({
+      'deno.json': JSON.stringify({ workspace: ['packages/noname'] }),
+      'packages/noname/deno.json': '{}',
+    })
+    try {
+      const detection = await detectWorkspace(dir, {
+        offline: true,
+        repoScope: 'scope',
+      })
+      assertEquals(detection.members?.[0]?.pkgName, '@scope/noname')
+      assertEquals(detection.members?.[0]?.description, '-')
+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+    const pnpmDir = await mk({
+      'pnpm-workspace.yaml': 'packages:\n  - packages/**\n',
+      'packages/nn/package.json': '{}',
+    })
+    try {
+      const detection = await detectWorkspace(pnpmDir)
+      assertEquals(detection.members?.[0]?.pkgName, 'nn')
+      assertEquals(detection.members?.[0]?.description, '-')
+    } finally {
+      await rm(pnpmDir)
+    }
+  })
+  await t.step(
+    'cargo root without a workspace section has no members',
+    async () => {
+      const dir = await mk({
+        'Cargo.toml': '[package]\nname = "solo"',
+      })
+      try {
+        const detection = await detectWorkspace(dir)
+        assertEquals(detection.members, [])
+      } finally {
+        await rm(dir)
+      }
+    },
+  )
+  await t.step('cargo members fall back to folder names', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({
+      'Cargo.toml': '[workspace]\nmembers = ["crates/empty", "crates/named"]',
+      'crates/empty/Cargo.toml': '',
+      'crates/named/Cargo.toml':
+        '[package]\nname = "named"\ndescription = "Named crate"',
+    })
+    try {

+      assertEquals(detection.language, 'rs')
+      assertEquals(detection.packageRegistry, 'crates.io')
+      const empty = detection.members?.find((m) => m.pkgName === 'empty')
+      assertEquals(empty?.description, '-')
+      const named = detection.members?.find((m) => m.pkgName === 'named')
+      assertEquals(named?.description, 'Named crate')
+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+  })
+
+  await t.step('root cargo package metadata is kept', async () => {

+members = ["crates/one", "crates/two"]

+[package]
+name = "root-crate"
+description = "Root crate"`,
+      'crates/one/Cargo.toml': `[package]

+name = "crate-two"`,
+    })

+      assertEquals(detection.packageRegistry, 'crates.io')

+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+  })

+  await t.step(

+      })

+        assertEquals(detection.packageRegistry, 'jsr')
+        assertEquals(detection.members, [])
+      } finally {
+        await rm(dir)
+      }
+    },
+  )

+  await t.step('deno.jsonc and memberless deno config', async () => {

+Deno.test('runInit', async (t) => {
+  const mk = async (files: Record<string, string>): Promise<string> => {
+    const dir = await Deno.makeTempDir()
+    for (const [filePath, content] of Object.entries(files)) {
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(`${dir}/${filePath}`, content)
+    }
+    return dir
+  }
+  const rm = (dir: string) => Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+  await t.step('scaffolds a config from the detected project', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({
+      'package.json': JSON.stringify({ name: 'some-pkg' }),
+      'LICENSE.txt': 'MIT License',
+    })
+    try {
+      const result = await runInit({ rootPath: dir })
+      assertEquals(result.written, true)
+      assertEquals(result.configPath, `${dir}/readma.config.ts`)
+      const written = await Deno.readTextFile(result.configPath)
+      assertEquals(written, result.content)
+      assertEquals(written.includes("license: 'MIT'"), true)
+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+  })
+  await t.step('refuses to overwrite without force', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({
+      'package.json': '{}',
+      'readma.config.ts': 'export default {}',
+    })
+    try {
+      const error = await assertRejects(() => runInit({ rootPath: dir }))
+      assertInstanceOf(error, ReadmaError)
+      assertEquals(error.message.includes('--force'), true)
+      const forced = await runInit({ rootPath: dir, force: true })
+      assertEquals(forced.written, true)
+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+  })
+  await t.step('dryRun skips the write', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({ 'package.json': '{}' })
+    try {
+      const result = await runInit({ rootPath: dir, dryRun: true })
+      assertEquals(result.written, false)
+      const stat = await Deno.stat(`${dir}/readma.config.ts`).catch(() =>
+        undefined
+      )
+      assertEquals(stat, undefined)
+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+  })
+  await t.step('custom config path', async () => {
+    const dir = await mk({ 'package.json': '{}' })
+    try {
+      const result = await runInit({
+        rootPath: dir,
+        configPath: 'custom.config.ts',
+      })
+      assertEquals(result.configPath, `${dir}/custom.config.ts`)
+    } finally {
+      await rm(dir)
+    }
+  })
+})

+    } finally {

+  })

+import { join } from '@std/path'
+import * as yml from '@std/yaml'
+import {
+  detectBranch,
+  detectLicense,
+  io,
+  type LicenseInfo,
+  readOptionalFile,
+} from './io.ts'
+import { shields, type ShieldsArgs } from './shields.ts'
+import {
+  COC_FILE_PATH,
+  type GlobalOptions,
+  type ReadmeTemplateArgs,
+} from './types.ts'
+import { ReadmaError } from './utils.ts'
+
+/** Fully resolved values used to render a readme without further side effects */
+export type ReadmeContext = {
+  /** Merged template args */
+  args: ReadmeTemplateArgs
+  /** Defaulted global options */
+  options: DefaultedGlobalOptions
+  /** Repository url */
+  repoUrl: string
+  /** Documentation url, default to the repo url */
+  docUrl: string
+  /** Demo url, default to the repo url */
+  demoUrl: string
+  /** Current branch */
+  branch: string
+  /** Full email address */
+  fullEmail: string
+  /** Logo image absolute url */
+  logoSrc: string
+  /** Screenshot image absolute url, undefined when not provided */
+  screenshotSrc: string | undefined
+  /** Resolved license informations */
+  license: LicenseInfo
+  /** Code of conduct file path if found */
+  cocPath: string | undefined
+  /** Resolved shields */
+  badgeList: ReturnType<typeof shields>
+  /** Pre resolved issue template urls */
+  issueUrls: { bug: string; feat: string }
+}
+/** Global options with their defaults applied */
+export type DefaultedGlobalOptions = Required<GlobalOptions>
+
+/** Apply defaults to the global options */
+export function defaultOptions(
+  options: Partial<GlobalOptions>,
+): DefaultedGlobalOptions {
+  return {
+    workspaceRootPath: '.',
+    dryRun: false,
+    folderPath: '.',
+    ...options,
+  }
+}
+
+/** Compute the repo url from the template args */
+export function repoUrlFromArgs(args: ReadmeTemplateArgs): string {
+  const vcsName = args.vcsName ?? 'github'
+  return args.urls?.repo ??
+    `https://${vcsName}.com/${args.githubUsername}/${args.repoName}`
+}
+
+/** Raw issue template front matter */
+export type IssueTemplateMeta = {
+  title: string
+  labels: string
+  assignees: string[]
+}
+
+/** Read a github issue template file and derive its pre filled new issue url */
+export async function issueTemplateUrl(
+  rootPath: string,
+  repoUrl: string,
+  templateFilename: string,
+): Promise<string> {
+  const fallbackUrl = `${repoUrl}/issues/new?template=${
+    encodeURIComponent(templateFilename)
+  }`
+  const filePath = join(rootPath, '.github', 'ISSUE_TEMPLATE', templateFilename)
+  const fileStr = await readOptionalFile(filePath)
+  if (fileStr === undefined) return fallbackUrl
+  try {
+    const meta = yml.parse(fileStr) as Partial<IssueTemplateMeta>
+    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams({
+      title: meta.title ?? '',
+      labels: meta.labels ?? '',
+      assignees: (meta.assignees ?? []).toString(),
+    })
+    return `${repoUrl}/issues/new?template=${templateFilename}&${urlParams}`
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ReadmaError(
+      `Could not parse the github issue template at ${filePath}`,
+      { cause: error },
+    )
+  }
+}
+
+/** Dependencies of {@link resolveContext} which can be injected for tests */
+export type ResolveContextDeps = {
+  detectBranch: typeof detectBranch
+  detectLicense: typeof detectLicense
+}
+
+/** Resolve every async/env dependent value once, so that rendering stays pure */
+export async function resolveContext(
+  args: ReadmeTemplateArgs,
+  options: Partial<GlobalOptions> = {},
+  deps: Partial<ResolveContextDeps> = {},
+): Promise<ReadmeContext> {
+  const defaultedOptions = defaultOptions(options)
+  const branch = await (deps.detectBranch ?? detectBranch)(
+    defaultedOptions.workspaceRootPath,
+  )
+  const license = await (deps.detectLicense ?? detectLicense)(
+    defaultedOptions.workspaceRootPath,
+  )
+  const licenseId = args.license ?? license.id
+  const resolvedLicense: LicenseInfo = {
+    id: licenseId,
+    file: args.licenseFile ?? license.file ?? 'LICENSE.txt',
+  }
+  const repoUrl = repoUrlFromArgs(args)
+  const docUrl = args.urls?.doc ?? repoUrl
+  const demoUrl = args.urls?.demo ?? repoUrl
+  const vcsName = args.vcsName ?? 'github'
+  const domainExt = args.domainExt ?? 'com'
+  const fullEmail = `${args.email}@${args.domain}.${domainExt}`
+  const ghContentUrl = (x = '') =>
+    `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${args.githubUsername}/${args.repoName}/HEAD/${x}`
+  const logoSrc = ghContentUrl(args.images.logo)
+  const screenshotSrc = args.images.screenshot
+    ? ghContentUrl(args.images.screenshot)
+    : undefined
+  const cocFileContent = await readOptionalFile(
+    join(defaultedOptions.workspaceRootPath, COC_FILE_PATH),
+  )
+  const cocPath = args.coc ??
+    (cocFileContent === undefined ? undefined : COC_FILE_PATH)
+  const badgeList = shields(
+    {
+      packageRegistry: args.packageRegistry,
+      vcsName,
+      repoName: args.repoName,
+      repoUrl,
+      githubUsername: args.githubUsername,
+      workspaceMember: args.workspaceMember,
+      badgeStyle: args.badgeStyle,
+      commitActivityInterval: 'w',
+      branch,
+      language: args.language,
+      linkedinUsername: args.linkedinUsername,
+      badges: args.badges,
+    } satisfies ShieldsArgs,
+  )
+  const [bugUrl, featUrl] = await Promise.all([
+    issueTemplateUrl(
+      defaultedOptions.workspaceRootPath,
+      repoUrl,
+      args.template.bugReport,
+    ),
+    issueTemplateUrl(
+      defaultedOptions.workspaceRootPath,
+      repoUrl,
+      args.template.featRequest,
+    ),
+  ])
+  return {
+    args,
+    options: defaultedOptions,
+    repoUrl,
+    docUrl,
+    demoUrl,
+    branch,
+    fullEmail,
+    logoSrc,
+    screenshotSrc,
+    license: resolvedLicense,
+    cocPath,
+    badgeList,
+    issueUrls: { bug: bugUrl, feat: featUrl },
+  }
+}
+
+/** Fetch a remote json description, return undefined on failure or when offline */
+export async function fetchJsonDescription(
+  url: string,
+  offline: boolean,
+  fetchFn: typeof fetch = io.fetch,
+): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  if (offline) return undefined
+  try {
+    const response = await fetchFn(url, {
+      headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
+    })
+    if (response.ok) {
+      const body = await response.json()
+      return typeof body?.description === 'string' && body.description
+        ? body.description
+        : undefined
+    }
+    return undefined
+  } catch {
+    return undefined
+  }
+}

+import * as path from '@std/path'
+import { ReadmaError } from './utils.ts'
+import type { ReadmeTemplateArgs } from './types.ts'
+
+/** Minimal side effects surface, injectable for tests */
+export type ReadmaIo = {
+  readTextFile: (filePath: string) => Promise<string>
+  cwd: () => string
+  runCommand: (
+    command: { cmd: string; args: string[]; cwd?: string },
+  ) => Promise<{ success: boolean; stdout: string; stderr: string }>
+  fetch: typeof fetch
+}
+
+/** Default {@link ReadmaIo} backed by Deno APIs */
+export const defaultIo: ReadmaIo = {
+  readTextFile: (filePath) => Deno.readTextFile(filePath),
+  cwd: () => Deno.cwd(),
+  runCommand: async ({ cmd, args, cwd }) => {
+    const process = new Deno.Command(cmd, {
+      args,
+      cwd,
+      stdout: 'piped',
+      stderr: 'piped',
+    })
+    const { success, stdout, stderr } = await process.output()
+    return {
+      success,
+      stdout: new TextDecoder().decode(stdout),
+      stderr: new TextDecoder().decode(stderr),
+    }
+  },
+  fetch: (input, init) => fetch(input, init),
+}
+
+/** Current side effects surface, override it with {@link setIo} for tests */
+export let io: ReadmaIo = defaultIo
+
+/** Override the side effects surface with a partial one, useful for tests */
+export function setIo(overrides: Partial<ReadmaIo>): void {
+  io = { ...defaultIo, ...overrides }
+}
+
+/** Restore the default side effects surface */
+export function resetIo(): void {
+  io = defaultIo
+}
+
+/** Read a file, return undefined if it does not exist */
+export async function readOptionalFile(filePath: string): Promise<
+  string | undefined
+> {
+  try {
+    return await io.readTextFile(filePath)
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error instanceof Deno.errors.NotFound) return undefined
+    throw error
+  }
+}
+
+/** Candidate license filenames, in detection order */
+export const LICENSE_FILENAMES = [
+  'LICENSE.txt',
+  'LICENSE.md',
+  'LICENSE',
+  'LICENCE.txt',
+  'LICENCE.md',
+  'LICENCE',
+  'LICENSE-MIT',
+] as const
+
+/** Detected license informations */
+export type LicenseInfo = {
+  /** SPDX license identifier */
+  id?: string
+  /** License file path relative to the given root path */
+  file?: string
+}
+
+/** Match a license file content to a SPDX license identifier */
+export function matchLicense(content: string): string | undefined {
+  const head = content.slice(0, 600).toLowerCase()
+  if (head.includes('mit license')) return 'MIT'
+  if (head.includes('apache license')) return 'Apache-2.0'
+  if (head.includes('mozilla public license')) return 'MPL-2.0'
+  if (head.includes('gnu general public license')) return 'GPL-3.0'
+  if (head.includes('bsd')) return 'BSD-3-Clause'
+  return undefined
+}
+
+/** Detect the license file and its SPDX identifier inside the given root path */
+export async function detectLicense(rootPath = '.'): Promise<LicenseInfo> {
+  for (const filename of LICENSE_FILENAMES) {
+    const filePath = path.join(rootPath, filename)
+    const content = await readOptionalFile(filePath)
+    if (content !== undefined) {
+      return { id: matchLicense(content), file: filename }
+    }
+  }
+  return {}
+}
+
+/** Detect the current git branch, fallback to `main` */
+export async function detectBranch(rootPath = '.'): Promise<string> {
+  const envBranch = Deno.env.get('GITHUB_HEAD_REF') ??
+    Deno.env.get('GITHUB_REF_NAME')
+  if (envBranch) return envBranch
+  const result = await io.runCommand({
+    cmd: 'git',
+    args: ['rev-parse', '--abbrev-ref', 'HEAD'],
+    cwd: rootPath,
+  })
+  const branch = result.stdout.trim()
+  return result.success && branch && branch !== 'HEAD' ? branch : 'main'
+}
+
+/** Load the `readma.config.ts` file at the given root folder or file path */
+export async function getReadmaConfig(
+  configPathRoot = '.',
+): Promise<ReadmeTemplateArgs> {
+  const isFile = configPathRoot.endsWith('.ts')
+  const configPath = isFile
+    ? path.resolve(io.cwd(), configPathRoot)
+    : path.resolve(io.cwd(), configPathRoot, 'readma.config.ts')
+  const mod = await import(path.toFileUrl(configPath).href)
+  const config = (mod as { default?: ReadmeTemplateArgs }).default
+  if (!config) {
+    throw new ReadmaError(
+      `Expected ${configPath} to default export a readma config`,
+    )
+  }
+  return config
+}

+import type { PackageRegistry, SourceLanguage } from './types.ts'
+import { md } from './utils.ts'
+import type { ReadmeContext } from './context.ts'

+/** A readme section definition */
+export type SectionDef = {
+  /** Unique section id */
+  id: string
+  /** Displayed section title, also used to derive the toc anchor */
+  title: string
+  /** Render the section body, return undefined or an empty string to skip the section */
+  render: (ctx: ReadmeContext) => string | undefined
+}
+
+/** Installation snippet for a package, derived from the language and registry */
+export function installSnippet(
+  pkgName: string,
+  language: SourceLanguage,
+  packageRegistry: PackageRegistry | undefined,
+): string | undefined {
+  if (language === 'ts' && packageRegistry === 'jsr') {
+    return md.code(`deno add ${pkgName}`)
+  }
+  if (language === 'ts' && packageRegistry === 'npm') {
+    return [
+      md.code(`pnpm add ${pkgName}`),
+      md.code(`npm add ${pkgName}`),
+      md.code(`yarn add ${pkgName}`),
+      md.code(`deno add npm:${pkgName}`),
+      md.code(`bun add ${pkgName}`),
+    ].join('\n')
+  }
+  if (language === 'rs') return md.code(`cargo add ${pkgName}`)
+  return undefined
+}
+
+/** Sections derived from the custom (non builtin) keys of `args.sections` */
+export function customSections(ctx: ReadmeContext): SectionDef[] {
+  const customKeys = Object.keys(ctx.args.sections).filter((key) =>
+    !(BUILTIN_SECTION_IDS as readonly string[]).includes(key)
+  )
+  return customKeys.map((key) => ({
+    id: key,
+    title: key,
+    render: () => ctx.args.sections[key],
+  }))
+}

+/** About section body, with the optional screenshot and the workspace members table */
+function aboutSection(ctx: ReadmeContext): string {
+  const { args } = ctx
+  const screenshot = ctx.screenshotSrc
+    ? `<img src="${ctx.screenshotSrc}" alt="Product screenshot" />\n`
+    : ''
+  const members = args.root && args.root.members.length > 0
+    ? `
+
+> [!TIP]
+> You are inside the entry point of **${args.repoName}** workspace, here is a list of available packages
+
+${markdownMembersTable(args.root.members)}
+`
+    : ''
+  return `${args.sections.about.trim()}
+
+${screenshot}${members}`.trim()
+}
+
+/** Markdown table listing the workspace members */
+export function markdownMembersTable(
+  members: { pkgName: string; path: string; description: string }[],
+): string {
+  const header = ['Package', 'Description']
+  const rows = members.map(({ pkgName, path: memberPath, description }) => [
+    `[${pkgName}](${memberPath})`,
+    description,
+  ])
+  return markdownTable([header, ...rows])
+}
+
+/** Builtin section ids which are not rendered as custom sections */
+export const BUILTIN_SECTION_IDS = [
+  'projectDescription',
+  'about',
+  'features',
+  'gettingStarted',
+  'installation',
+  'usage',
+  'roadmap',
+  'contributing',
+  'acknowledgments',
+] as const
+
+/** Render every section definition, skipping the empty ones */
+export function renderSections(
+  ctx: ReadmeContext,
+  defs: SectionDef[],
+  renderSection: (title: string, content: string | undefined) => string,
+): string {
+  const rendered: string[] = []
+  for (const def of defs) {
+    const content = def.render(ctx)
+    if (content !== undefined && content.trim() !== '') {
+      rendered.push(renderSection(def.title, content))
+    }
+  }
+  return rendered.join('\n')
+}
+
+/** Minimal markdown table renderer (kept dependency free for the common case) */
+export function markdownTable(rows: string[][]): string {
+  if (rows.length === 0) return ''
+  const columnCount = Math.max(...rows.map((row) => row.length))
+  const widths = Array.from(
+    { length: columnCount },
+    (_, columnIndex) =>
+      Math.max(...rows.map((row) => (row[columnIndex] ?? '').length)),
+  )
+  const formatRow = (row: string[]) =>
+    `| ${
+      Array.from(
+        { length: columnCount },
+        (_, columnIndex) =>
+          (row[columnIndex] ?? '').padEnd(widths[columnIndex]),
+      ).join(' | ')
+    } |`
+  const separator = `| ${
+    widths.map((width) => '-'.repeat(width)).join(' | ')
+  } |`
+  return [
+    formatRow(rows[0]),
+    separator,
+    ...rows.slice(1).map((row) => formatRow(row)),
+  ].join('\n')
+}

+/**
+ * Slugify a markdown heading the same way GitHub does it for its anchors.
+ *
+ * The algorithm: lowercase, drop every character which is not a word
+ * character, a space, an underscore or an hyphen (this includes emojis and
+ * punctuation), then turn spaces into hyphens (without collapsing them).
+ *
+ * @example
+ * ```ts
+ * ghSlug('About the project') // 'about-the-project'
+ * ghSlug('💡 Features') // '-features'
+ * ghSlug('Contact & support') // 'contact--support'
+ * ```
+ */
+export function ghSlug(heading: string): string {
+  const cleaned = heading
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .replaceAll(/[^\p{L}\p{N} _-]/gu, '')
+  return cleaned.replaceAll(' ', '-')
 }

+import { assertEquals, assertInstanceOf, assertRejects } from '@std/assert'
+import {
+  defaultOptions,
+  fetchJsonDescription,
+  issueTemplateUrl,
+  type ReadmeContext,
+  repoUrlFromArgs,
+  resolveContext,
+} from '../src/context.ts'
+import { resetIo, setIo } from '../src/io.ts'
+import { COC_FILE_PATH, type ReadmeTemplateArgs } from '../src/types.ts'
+import { ReadmaError } from '../src/utils.ts'
+
+const baseArgs: ReadmeTemplateArgs = {
+  language: 'ts',
+  title: 'Test',
+  author: 'me',
+  githubUsername: 'me',
+  repoName: 'test-repo',
+  xHandle: 'me',
+  domain: 'gmail',
+  email: 'me',
+  images: { logo: 'images/logo.png' },
+  template: { bugReport: 'bug.yml', featRequest: 'feat.yml' },
+  backToTop: false,
+  sections: {
+    features: 'features',
+    projectDescription: 'desc',
+    about: 'about',
+    installation: 'install',
+    acknowledgments: 'thanks',
+    gettingStarted: 'start',
+    roadmap: 'road',
+    usage: 'usage',
+  },
+}
+
+Deno.test('repoUrlFromArgs', () => {
+  assertEquals(
+    repoUrlFromArgs(baseArgs),
+    'https://github.com/me/test-repo',
+  )
+  assertEquals(
+    repoUrlFromArgs({ ...baseArgs, urls: { repo: 'https://custom.dev/repo' } }),
+    'https://custom.dev/repo',
+  )
+  assertEquals(
+    repoUrlFromArgs({ ...baseArgs, vcsName: 'github' }),
+    'https://github.com/me/test-repo',
+  )
+})
+
+Deno.test('defaultOptions', () => {
+  assertEquals(defaultOptions({}), {
+    workspaceRootPath: '.',
+    dryRun: false,
+    folderPath: '.',
+  })
+  assertEquals(
+    defaultOptions({ workspaceRootPath: '/root', dryRun: true }),
+    {
+      workspaceRootPath: '/root',
+      dryRun: true,
+      folderPath: '.',
+    },
+  )
+})
+
+Deno.test('issueTemplateUrl', async (t) => {
+  const dir = await Deno.makeTempDir()
+  try {
+    await Deno.mkdir(`${dir}/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE`, { recursive: true })
+    await Deno.writeTextFile(
+      `${dir}/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug.yml`,
+      `name: Bug report
+title: 'Bug: something broke'
+labels: ['bug']
+assignees: ['me', 'you']
+body: []`,
+    )
+    await t.step('derives a prefilled url from the yml template', async () => {
+      const url = await issueTemplateUrl(
+        dir,
+        'https://github.com/me/repo',
+        'bug.yml',
+      )
+      assertEquals(
+        url,
+        'https://github.com/me/repo/issues/new?template=bug.yml&title=Bug%3A+something+broke&labels=bug&assignees=me%2Cyou',
+      )
+    })
+    await t.step('falls back when the template is missing', async () => {
+      const url = await issueTemplateUrl(
+        dir,
+        'https://github.com/me/repo',
+        'missing.yml',
+      )
+      assertEquals(
+        url,
+        'https://github.com/me/repo/issues/new?template=missing.yml',
+      )
+    })
+    await t.step('defaults empty yml meta fields', async () => {
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(
+        `${dir}/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/minimal.yml`,
+        'name: Minimal\nbody: []',
+      )
+      const url = await issueTemplateUrl(
+        dir,
+        'https://github.com/me/repo',
+        'minimal.yml',
+      )
+      assertEquals(
+        url.includes('title=&labels=&assignees='),
+        true,
+      )
+    })
+    await t.step('throws a ReadmaError on invalid yml', async () => {
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(
+        `${dir}/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/broken.yml`,
+        'a: [unclosed',
+      )

+      assertEquals(detected.id, 'Apache-2.0')
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(`${dir}/LICENSE.txt`, 'MIT License')
+      const withTxt = await detectLicense(dir)
+      assertEquals(withTxt.file, 'LICENSE.txt')
+      assertEquals(withTxt.id, 'MIT')
+      assertEquals(LICENSE_FILENAMES[0], 'LICENSE.txt')
+    } finally {
+      await Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+    }
+  })

+    assertEquals(result.length > 0, true)
+  })
+  await t.step('detectBranch falls back to main', async () => {
+    setIo({
+      runCommand: () =>
+        Promise.resolve({ success: true, stdout: 'HEAD\n', stderr: '' }),
+    })
+    try {
+      assertEquals(await detectBranch('.'), 'main')

+Deno.test('processFile', async (t) => {
+  const dir = await Deno.makeTempDir()
+  try {
+    await t.step('renders an existing file', async () => {
+      const filePath = `${dir}/doc.mdx`
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(filePath, '# Doc')
+      const html = await processFile(filePath)
+      assertEquals(html?.includes('Doc'), true)
+    })
+    await t.step('returns undefined for a missing file', async () => {
+      assertEquals(await processFile(`${dir}/missing.mdx`), undefined)
+    })
+    await t.step('wraps render errors in a ReadmaError', async () => {
+      const filePath = `${dir}/broken.mdx`
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(filePath, '<NotAComponent />')
+      const error = await assertRejects(() => processFile(filePath))
+      assertInstanceOf(error, ReadmaError)
+    })
+    await t.step('propagates read errors', async () => {
+      setIo({
+        readTextFile: () => Promise.reject(new Error('disk failure')),
+      })
+      try {
+        await assertRejects(
+          () => processFile(`${dir}/any.mdx`),
+          Error,
+          'disk failure',
+        )
+      } finally {
+        resetIo()
+      }
+    })
+  } finally {
+    await Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+  }
+})

+Deno.test('writeReadme writes and honours dryRun', async (t) => {
+  stubBranchIo()
+  const dir = await Deno.makeTempDir()
+  try {
+    await t.step('dryRun skips the write', async () => {
+      const out = await writeReadme(baseArgs, {
+        workspaceRootPath: dir,
+        folderPath: dir,
+        dryRun: true,
+      })
+      assertEquals(out.length > 0, true)
+      const stat = await Deno.stat(`${dir}/README.md`).catch(() => undefined)
+      assertEquals(stat, undefined)
+    })
+    await t.step('writes the README.md', async () => {
+      await writeReadme(baseArgs, {
+        workspaceRootPath: dir,
+        folderPath: dir,
+      })
+      const written = await Deno.readTextFile(`${dir}/README.md`)
+      assertEquals(written, await readme(baseArgs, { workspaceRootPath: dir }))
+    })
+    await t.step(
+      'default folderPath follows the workspace member',
+      async () => {
+        await Deno.mkdir(`${dir}/packages/m`, { recursive: true })
+        await writeReadme(
+          {
+            ...baseArgs,
+            workspaceMember: {
+              pkgName: '@s/m',
+              path: 'packages/m',
+              description: '-',
+            },
+          },
+          { workspaceRootPath: dir, dryRun: false },
+        )
+        const memberWritten = await Deno.readTextFile(
+          `${dir}/packages/m/README.md`,
+        )
+        assertEquals(memberWritten.includes('readme-top'), true)
+        await writeReadme(baseArgs, { workspaceRootPath: dir, dryRun: false })
+        const rootWritten = await Deno.readTextFile(`${dir}/README.md`)
+        assertEquals(rootWritten.includes('readme-top'), true)
+      },
+    )
+    await t.step('throws when the folder is missing', async () => {
+      const error = await assertRejects(() =>
+        writeReadme(baseArgs, {
+          workspaceRootPath: dir,
+          folderPath: `${dir}/nope/missing`,
+        })
+      )
+      assertEquals((error as Error).message.includes('folder to exist'), true)
+    })
+  } finally {
+    await Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+    resetIo()
+  }
+})
