+import { assertEquals } from '@std/assert'
+import { Tocer } from '../src/toc.ts'
+
+Deno.test('Tocer renders a toc with github compatible anchors', () => {
+  const tocer = new Tocer(false)
+  tocer.section('💡 About the project', 'About body')
+  tocer.section('✨ Features', 'Features body')
+  const toc = tocer.toc()
+  assertEquals(
+    toc.includes('<a href="#-about-the-project">💡 About the project</a>'),
+    true,
+  )
+  assertEquals(toc.includes('<a href="#-features">✨ Features</a>'), true)
+  assertEquals(toc.includes('<summary>Table of contents</summary>'), true)
+})
+
+Deno.test('Tocer deduplicates anchors', () => {
+  const tocer = new Tocer(false)
+  tocer.section('Notes', 'a')
+  tocer.section('Notes', 'b')
+  tocer.section('Notes', 'c')
+  const toc = tocer.toc()
+  assertEquals(toc.includes('href="#notes"'), true)
+  assertEquals(toc.includes('href="#notes-1"'), true)
+  assertEquals(toc.includes('href="#notes-2"'), true)
+})
+
+Deno.test('Tocer custom title and hide', () => {
+  const titled = new Tocer(false, { title: 'Sommaire' })
+  titled.section('A', 'b')
+  assertEquals(titled.toc().includes('<summary>Sommaire</summary>'), true)
+  const hidden = new Tocer(true, { hide: true })
+  hidden.section('A', 'b')
+  assertEquals(hidden.toc(), '')
+  const empty = new Tocer(false)
+  assertEquals(empty.toc(), '')
+})
+
+Deno.test('Tocer section rendering', () => {
+  const tocer = new Tocer(true)
+  const withContent = tocer.section('Title', '  Body  ')
+  assertEquals(
+    withContent,
+    `## Title
+
+Body
+
+<p align="right">(<a href="#readme-top">back to top</a>)</p>
+`,
+  )
+  const withoutContent = tocer.section('Empty', undefined)
+  assertEquals(withoutContent.includes('## Empty'), true)
+  const noBackToTop = new Tocer(false).section('T', 'C')
+  assertEquals(noBackToTop.includes('back to top'), false)
+})

-import type { PackageJson } from 'types-package-json'

+/** Minimal typed subset of a package.json file */
+export type PackageJson = {
+  name?: string
+  version?: string
+  description?: string
+  private?: boolean
+  type?: string
+  workspaces?: string[] | { packages: string[] }
+  license?: string
+}
+/** Expected folder name of the package manifest */
+export const PKG_JSON_FILENAME = 'package.json' as const
+/** Read the raw package.json content of a package folder */
+async function readPkgJsonFile(packageFolder: string): Promise<string> {
+  try {
+    return await Deno.readTextFile(`${packageFolder}/${PKG_JSON_FILENAME}`)
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error instanceof Deno.errors.NotFound) {
+      throw new TypeError(
+        `Expected a ${PKG_JSON_FILENAME} file inside ${packageFolder}`,
+        { cause: error },
+      )
+    }
+    throw error
+  }
+}
+/**
+ * Return a typed package.json object if found for the given package folder
+ * @param packageFolder Folder which should contain a `package.json` file
+ * @throws {TypeError} When the folder does not contain a `package.json` file
+ * @throws {Error} When the `package.json` file is not parsable
+ */
+export async function loadPkgJson(
+  packageFolder: string,
+): Promise<PackageJson> {
+  const content = await readPkgJsonFile(packageFolder)
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(content) as PackageJson
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new Error(
+      `Could not parse the ${PKG_JSON_FILENAME} file inside ${packageFolder}`,
+      { cause: error },
+    )
+  }
 }

+Deno.test('loadPkgJson', async (t) => {
+  const dir = await Deno.makeTempDir()
+  try {
+    await t.step('loads a valid package.json', async () => {
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(
+        `${dir}/package.json`,
+        JSON.stringify({
+          name: '@scope/pkg',
+          version: '1.0.0',
+          description: 'A package',
+        }),
+      )
+      const pkg = await loadPkgJson(dir)
+      assertEquals(pkg.name, '@scope/pkg')
+      assertEquals(pkg.version, '1.0.0')
+      assertEquals(pkg.description, 'A package')
+    })
+    await t.step('throws when the file is missing', async () => {
+      const error = await assertRejects(() =>
+        loadPkgJson(`${dir}/nope`)
+      ) as Error
+      assertEquals(error.message.includes('package.json'), true)
+    })
+    await t.step('throws on invalid json', async () => {
+      await Deno.mkdir(`${dir}/broken`, { recursive: true })
+      await Deno.writeTextFile(`${dir}/broken/package.json`, '{invalid')
+      const error = await assertRejects(() =>
+        loadPkgJson(`${dir}/broken`)
+      ) as Error
+      assertEquals(error.message.includes('parse'), true)
+    })
+    await t.step('rethrows non NotFound errors', async () => {
+      await Deno.mkdir(`${dir}/isdir/package.json`, { recursive: true })
+      await assertRejects(() => loadPkgJson(`${dir}/isdir`))
+    })
+  } finally {
+    await Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+  }
 })

+/**
+ * Root level tests which dogfood the readma repository itself.
+ * They only run from the repository root because they rely on the repo config.
+ */
+import { assertEquals } from '@std/assert'
+import { loadConfig } from '../packages/cli/src/config.ts'
+import { runInit } from '../packages/cli/src/init.ts'
+import { runValidate } from '../packages/cli/src/validate.ts'
+
+Deno.test('loadConfig without a path reads the repo config', async () => {
+  const { args } = await loadConfig()
+  assertEquals(args.title, 'Readma')
+})
+
+Deno.test('runValidate on the readma repo itself', async () => {
+  const result = await runValidate()
+  assertEquals(result.ok, true)
+  assertEquals(result.issues, [])
+})
+
+Deno.test('runInit with an absolute config path', async () => {
+  const dir = await Deno.makeTempDir()
+  try {
+    await Deno.writeTextFile(
+      `${dir}/package.json`,
+      JSON.stringify({ name: 'abs-pkg' }),
+    )
+    const result = await runInit({
+      configPath: `${dir}/abs.config.ts`,
+    })
+    assertEquals(result.configPath, `${dir}/abs.config.ts`)
+    assertEquals(result.written, true)
+  } finally {
+    await Deno.remove(dir, { recursive: true })
+  }
+})
+
+Deno.test('runGen defaults to the repository root', async () => {
+  const { runGen } = await import('../packages/cli/src/gen.ts')
+  const result = await runGen({ dryRun: true, offline: true, rootOnly: true })
+  assertEquals(result.rendered.length, 1)
+  assertEquals(result.rendered[0].content.includes('Readma'), true)
+})
